visualCharacteristics: rc11: Light grey vertical gradient (#f5f7fa to white). Single slide on this page. New block as directed: text-only quote slides (quote mark, bold quotation, rule + attribution). Hide controls when there is one slide, as on this page.

contentPattern.authoring: One row per slide, one cell: quotation paragraph(s), then the attribution as the last paragraph.

usage.description: Text-only quote slides with attribution; prev/next and dots only when there is more than one slide; no autoplay.

reuseGuidance: Use for client or executive quotes. Use carousel-promo for image slides.
